events.content:
Implemented — this now uses React/Next view transitions end-to-end.

**What Changed**
- Added page-level directional route transitions (`nav-forward` / `nav-back`) on both routes via `ViewTransition` wrappers in `app/page.tsx:1` and `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:1`.
- Added shared-element image morph by wrapping grid thumbnail + detail hero with the same transition `name` and explicit `share` class in `app/ProductGrid.tsx:15` and `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:56`.
- Tagged navigation intent with `transitionTypes` on links (`forward` on cards, `back` on back link) in `app/ProductGrid.tsx:13` and `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:52`.
- Animated Suspense handoff (skeleton → content) using `ViewTransition` on fallbacks/content in `app/page.tsx:20` and `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:66`.
- Added transition CSS (morph timing, directional slides, skeleton/content reveal, keyframes, pointer behavior) in `app/globals.css:16` and `app/globals.css:120`.
- Added reduced-motion compliance by disabling view-transition durations and skeleton pulse when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` in `app/globals.css:219`.

**Verification**
- Ran `npm run build` successfully (compiles + TypeScript + app routes generated).

If you want, I can tune the motion timings/easing to feel snappier or softer.
